items.label: Soft and Cozy Material
items.value: these women's basic shirts are made of 95% Cotton, 5% Spandex, comfortable to touch, lightweight, breathable, which are reasonably stretchy, form fitting and soft for multiple days. Light-colored shirts are a bit thin. Recommended to pair with light-colored underwear

items.label: Stylish Classic Design
items.value: these women's fitted shirts feature a crew neck, short sleeve, slim fit, solid color, and fine ribbing. The crew neck looks clean and shows off your long neck, and the slim fit shape shows off your curves, bringing you a more elegant temperament

items.label: Easy to Match
items.value: these women's crew neck shirts can be worn with jeans tucked into jeans, and sneakers for a casual look. If you attend a work occasion, you can wear a skirt, high heels, and add elegance. You can also match scarves, necklaces, bracelets and other accessories according to the weather and style

items.label: Proper Fit
items.value: the stretchy fabric gives you maximum freedom, and there are 5 sizes to choose from; Please refer to the size chart before purchasing; If you prefer a "loose fit", please order one size up than you normally wear

items.label: Package Included
items.value: you will get 3 pack women's fitted tops. These tops are well made and soft, combinations for you wearing in business casual, work, office, date, vacation, daily life, leisure, party, travel and suitable for everyday wear
